fusions.name: Sudden Landing
fusions.desc: Leaps you up to 7 tiles onto the target, then deals 13 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinprick Draught
fusions.desc: Flicks a barb that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Gorged Hop
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles and regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds, with +8% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Next Host
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a strike leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
